rationale: The only behavioral delta is that the fixed implementation increases the password array from 65 to 66 bytes. The Logic section identifies the fields as fixed-size arrays but does not specify the password array's size, any required terminator capacity, or a bounds-handling behavior that distinguishes the versions. Its general statement that fixed-size arrays define storage limits applies to both structures; the generic overflow-prevention phrasing is not an assertion of a check or mitigation present only in one version.
